shloka_text: कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य सुमाली नाम राक्षसः । रसातलान्मर्त्यलोकं सर्वं वै विचचार ह ।। 7.9.1 ।।
transliteration: kasyacittvatha kālasya sumālī nāma rākṣasaḥ | rasātalānmartyalokaṃ sarvaṃ vai vicacāra ha || 7.9.1 ||
translation: कस्यचित् of some, तु indeed, अथ then, कालस्य time, सुमाली Sumali, नाम named, राक्षसः demon, रसातलात् from Rasatala (the netherworld), मर्त्यलोकं to the mortal world, सर्वं all, वै indeed, विचचार wandered, ह (an emphatic particle).
explanation: Then, after some time, a demon named Sumali wandered throughout the entire mortal world, having come from Rasatala.
comments: From Patala, Sumali sees Kubera riding the Pushpaka and resolves to raise his line, bidding his daughter Kaikasi wed the sage Vishravas -- approaching him at a dread hour she is granted sons who, owing to the inauspicious time, will be cruel rakshasas, though her last shall be righteous -- she bears the ten-necked Dashagriva (Ravana), Kumbhakarna, Shurpanakha and the virtuous Vibhishana -- spurred by his mother's envy of Kubera, Ravana vows to equal him and departs to perform penance.

shloka_text: नीलजीमूतसङ्काशस्तप्तकाञ्चनकुण्डलः । कन्यां दुहितरं गृह्य विना पद्ममिव श्रियम् ।। 7.9.2 ।।
transliteration: nīlajīmūtasaṅkāśastaptakāñcanakuṇḍalaḥ | kanyāṃ duhitaraṃ gṛhya vinā padmamiva śriyam || 7.9.2 ||
translation: नीलजीमूतसङ्काशः resembling a dark cloud, तप्तकाञ्चनकुण्डलः wearing earrings of molten gold, कन्यां daughter, दुहितरं (his) daughter, गृह्य taking, विना without, पद्मम् a lotus, इव like, श्रियम् Lakshmi.
explanation: He, resembling a dark cloud and adorned with earrings of molten gold, took his daughter, who was as beautiful as Lakshmi without her lotus.

shloka_text: राक्षसेन्द्रः स तु तदा विचरन्वै महीतलम् । तदापश्यत्स गच्छन्तं पुष्पकेण धनेश्वरम् ।। 7.9.3 ।।
transliteration: rākṣasendraḥ sa tu tadā vicaranvai mahītalam | tadāpaśyatsa gacchantaṃ puṣpakeṇa dhaneśvaram || 7.9.3 ||
translation: राक्षसेन्द्रः the king of demons, सः he, तु indeed, तदा then, विचरन् wandering, वै indeed, महीतलम् on the earth's surface, तदा then, अपश्यत् saw, सः he, गच्छन्तं going, पुष्पकेण by the Pushpaka (aerial chariot), धनेश्वरम् the lord of wealth (Kubera).
explanation: While the king of demons was wandering on the surface of the earth, he then saw Kubera, the lord of wealth, traveling in the Pushpaka chariot.

shloka_text: गच्छन्तं पितरं द्रष्टुं पुलस्त्यतनयं विभुम् । तं दृष्ट्वा ऽमरसङ्काशं स्वच्छन्दं तपनोपमम् ।। 7.9.4 ।।
transliteration: gacchantaṃ pitaraṃ draṣṭuṃ pulastyatanayaṃ vibhum | taṃ dṛṣṭvā 'marasaṅkāśaṃ svacchandaṃ tapanopamam || 7.9.4 ||
translation: गच्छन्तं going, पितरं father, द्रष्टुं to see, पुलस्त्यतनयं son of Pulastya (Kubera), विभुम् the powerful one, तं him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, अमरसङ्काशं resembling an immortal, स्वच्छन्दं moving freely, तपनोपमम् resembling the sun.
explanation: Having seen him, the powerful son of Pulastya (Kubera), who was going to see his father, resembling an immortal, moving freely, and radiant like the sun.

shloka_text: रसातलं प्रविष्टः सन्मर्त्यलोकात्सविस्मयः । इत्येवं चिन्तयामास राक्षसानां महामतिः ।। 7.9.5 ।।
transliteration: rasātalaṃ praviṣṭaḥ sanmartyalokātsavismayaḥ | ityevaṃ cintayāmāsa rākṣasānāṃ mahāmatiḥ || 7.9.5 ||
translation: रसातलं to Rasatala, प्रविष्टः having entered, सन् being, मर्त्यलोकात् from the mortal world, सविस्मयः with wonder, इति thus, एवं in this manner, चिन्तयामास thought, राक्षसानां of the demons, महामतिः the great-minded one (Sumali).
explanation: Having returned to Rasatala from the mortal world, the great-minded Sumali, filled with wonder, began to ponder in this manner.

shloka_text: किं कृतं श्रेय इत्येवं वर्धेमहि कथं वयम् । अथाब्रवीत्सुतां रक्षः कैकसीं नाम नामतः ।। 7.9.6 ।।
transliteration: kiṃ kṛtaṃ śreya ityevaṃ vardhemahi kathaṃ vayam | athābravītsutāṃ rakṣaḥ kaikasīṃ nāma nāmataḥ || 7.9.6 ||
translation: किं what, कृतं done, श्रेयः good, इति thus, एवं in this manner, वर्धेमहि may we prosper, कथं how, वयम् we, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, सुतां to his daughter, रक्षः the Rakshasa, कैकसीं Kaikasi, नाम named, नामतः by name.
explanation: The Rakshasa then spoke to his daughter, Kaikasi by name, pondering how they might prosper and what good they should do.

shloka_text: पुत्रि प्रदानकालो ऽयं यौवनं व्यतिवर्तते । प्रत्याख्यानाच्च भीतैस्त्वं न वरैः प्रतिगृह्यसे ।। 7.9.7 ।।
transliteration: putri pradānakālo 'yaṃ yauvanaṃ vyativartate | pratyākhyānācca bhītaistvaṃ na varaiḥ pratigṛhyase || 7.9.7 ||
translation: पुत्रि O daughter, प्रदानकालः time for giving in marriage, अयम् this, यौवनं youth, व्यतिवर्तते is passing away, प्रत्याख्यानात् from rejection, च and, भीतैः by those who are afraid, त्वं you, न not, वरैः by suitors, प्रतिगृह्यसे are accepted.
explanation: O daughter, this is the time for your marriage, and your youth is passing; you are not being accepted by suitors, who are afraid of rejection.

shloka_text: त्वत्कृते च वयं सर्वे यन्त्रिता धर्मबुद्धयः । त्वं हि सर्वगुणोपेता श्रीः साक्षादिव पुत्रिके । कन्यापितृत्वं दुःखं हि सर्वेषां मानकाङ्क्षिणाम् ।। 7.9.8 ।।
transliteration: tvatkṛte ca vayaṃ sarve yantritā dharmabuddhayaḥ | tvaṃ hi sarvaguṇopetā śrīḥ sākṣādiva putrike | kanyāpitṛtvaṃ duḥkhaṃ hi sarveṣāṃ mānakāṅkṣiṇām || 7.9.8 ||
translation: त्वत्कृते for your sake, च and, वयं we, सर्वे all, यन्त्रिताः troubled, धर्मबुद्धयः righteous-minded, त्वं you, हि indeed, सर्वगुणोपेता endowed with all virtues, श्रीः goddess of fortune, साक्षात् directly, इव as if, पुत्रिके O daughter, कन्यापितृत्वं fatherhood of a daughter, दुःखं sorrow, हि indeed, सर्वेषां for all, मानकाङ्क्षिणाम् those desiring honor.
explanation: For your sake, all of us, though righteous-minded, are troubled, for you, O daughter, are indeed endowed with all virtues, like the goddess Shri herself; indeed, the fatherhood of a daughter is a sorrow for all who desire honor.

shloka_text: न ज्ञायते च कः कन्यां वरयेदिति कन्यके ।। 7.9.9 ।।
transliteration: na jñāyate ca kaḥ kanyāṃ varayediti kanyake || 7.9.9 ||
translation: न not, ज्ञायते is known, च and, कः who, कन्यां the daughter, वरयेत् would choose, इति thus, कन्यके O daughter.
explanation: And it is not known, O daughter, who would choose to marry such a maiden.

shloka_text: त्वं हि सर्वगुणोपेता श्रीः साक्षादिव पुत्रिके । मातुः कुलं पितृकुलं यत्र चैव प्रदीयते । कुलत्रयं सदा कन्या संशये स्थाप्य तिष्ठति ।। 7.9.10 ।।
transliteration: tvaṃ hi sarvaguṇopetā śrīḥ sākṣādiva putrike | mātuḥ kulaṃ pitṛkulaṃ yatra caiva pradīyate | kulatrayaṃ sadā kanyā saṃśaye sthāpya tiṣṭhati || 7.9.10 ||
translation: त्वं you, हि indeed, सर्वगुणोपेता endowed with all virtues, श्रीः goddess of fortune, साक्षात् directly, इव as if, पुत्रिके O daughter, मातुः of the mother, कुलं family, पितृकुलं father's family, यत्र where, च and, एव indeed, प्रदीयते is given, कुलत्रयं three families, सदा always, कन्या a daughter, संशये in doubt, स्थाप्य having placed, तिष्ठति remains.
explanation: O daughter, you are indeed endowed with all virtues, like the goddess Shri herself; a daughter always keeps three families—her mother's, her father's, and the one to which she is given—in a state of uncertainty.

shloka_text: सा त्वं मुनिवरं श्रेष्ठं प्रजापतिकुलोद्भवम् । भज विश्रवसं पुत्रि पौलस्त्यं वरय स्वयम् ।। 7.9.11 ।।
transliteration: sā tvaṃ munivaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prajāpatikulodbhavam | bhaja viśravasaṃ putri paulastyaṃ varaya svayam || 7.9.11 ||
translation: सा she, त्वं you, मुनिवरं the best of sages, श्रेष्ठं excellent, प्रजापतिकुलोद्भवम् born in the lineage of Prajapati, भज resort to, विश्रवसं Vishravas, पुत्रि O daughter, पौलस्त्यं son of Pulastya, वरय choose, स्वयम् yourself.
explanation: O daughter, you yourself should choose and resort to Vishravas, the excellent and best of sages, born in the lineage of Prajapati and son of Pulastya.

shloka_text: ईदृशास्ते भविष्यन्ति पुत्राः पुत्रि न संशयः । तेजसा भास्करसमो यादृशो ऽयं धनेश्वरः ।। 7.9.12 ।।
transliteration: īdṛśāste bhaviṣyanti putrāḥ putri na saṃśayaḥ | tejasā bhāskarasamo yādṛśo 'yaṃ dhaneśvaraḥ || 7.9.12 ||
translation: ईदृशाः such, ते your, भविष्यन्ति will be, पुत्राः sons, पुत्रि O daughter, न not, संशयः doubt, तेजसा by splendor, भास्करसमः equal to the sun, यादृशः like whom, अयं this, धनेश्वरः lord of wealth.
explanation: O daughter, without a doubt, your sons will be like this lord of wealth (Kubera), equal to the sun in splendor.

shloka_text: सा तु तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा कन्यका पितृगौरवात् । तत्रोपागम्य सा तस्थौ विश्रवा यत्र तप्यते ।। 7.9.13 ।।
transliteration: sā tu tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kanyakā pitṛgauravāt | tatropāgamya sā tasthau viśravā yatra tapyate || 7.9.13 ||
translation: सा she, तु indeed, तद्वचनं that word, श्रुत्वा having heard, कन्यका the maiden, पितृगौरवात् out of respect for her father, तत्र there, उपागम्य having approached, सा she, तस्थौ stood, विश्रवाः Vishravas, यत्र where, तप्यते was performing penance.
explanation: Having heard that instruction, the maiden, out of respect for her father, approached the place where Vishravas was performing penance and stood there.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राम पुलस्त्यतनयो द्विजः । अग्निहोत्रमुपातिष्ठच्चतुर्थ इव पावकः ।। 7.9.14 ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare rāma pulastyatanayo dvijaḥ | agnihotramupātiṣṭhaccaturtha iva pāvakaḥ || 7.9.14 ||
translation: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, राम O Rama, पुलस्त्यतनयः son of Pulastya, द्विजः the brahmin, अग्निहोत्रं the fire sacrifice, उपातिष्ठत् performed, चतुर्थः fourth, इव like, पावकः fire.
explanation: O Rama, in the meantime, the brahmin Vishravas, son of Pulastya, performed the Agnihotra ritual, appearing like a fourth sacred fire himself.

shloka_text: अविचिन्त्य तु तां वेलां दारुणां पितृगौरवात् । उपसृत्याग्रतस्तस्य चरणाधोमुखी स्थिता । विलिखन्ती मुहुर्भूमिमङ्गुष्ठाग्रेण भामिनी ।। 7.9.15 ।।
transliteration: avicintya tu tāṃ velāṃ dāruṇāṃ pitṛgauravāt | upasṛtyāgratastasya caraṇādhomukhī sthitā | vilikhantī muhurbhūmimaṅguṣṭhāgreṇa bhāminī || 7.9.15 ||
translation: अविचिन्त्य not considering, तु indeed, तां that, वेलां time, दारुणां dreadful, पितृगौरवात् out of respect for her father, उपसृत्य having approached, अग्रतः in front of, तस्य his, चरणाधोमुखी with face bowed towards his feet, स्थिता stood, विलिखन्ती scratching, मुहुः repeatedly, भूमिं the ground, अङ्गुष्ठाग्रेण with the tip of her big toe, भामिनी the beautiful woman.
explanation: Disregarding that dreadful time, out of respect for her father, the beautiful maiden approached and stood before him, her face bowed towards his feet, repeatedly scratching the ground with the tip of her big toe.

shloka_text: स तु तां वीक्ष्य सुश्रोणीं पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाम् । अब्रवीत्परमोदारो दीप्यमानां स्वतेजसा ।। 7.9.16 ।।
transliteration: sa tu tāṃ vīkṣya suśroṇīṃ pūrṇacandranibhānanām | abravītparamodāro dīpyamānāṃ svatejasā || 7.9.16 ||
translation: सः He, तु indeed, ताम् her, वीक्ष्य having seen, सुश्रोणीम् one with beautiful hips, पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाम् one whose face resembles the full moon, अब्रवीत् spoke, परमोदारो the most noble (sage), दीप्यमानाम् shining, स्वतेजसा with her own radiance
explanation: The exceedingly noble sage, having seen her, who had beautiful hips, a face like the full moon, and was shining with her own radiance, spoke to her.

shloka_text: भद्रे कस्यासि दुहिता कुतो वा त्वमिहागता । किं कार्यं कस्य वा हेतोस्तत्त्वतो ब्रूहि शोभने ।। 7.9.17 ।।
transliteration: bhadre kasyāsi duhitā kuto vā tvamihāgatā | kiṃ kāryaṃ kasya vā hetostattvato brūhi śobhane || 7.9.17 ||
translation: भद्रे O auspicious one, कस्यासि whose are you, दुहिता daughter, कुतो from where, वा or, त्वम् you, इह here, आगता have come, किम् what, कार्यम् purpose, कस्य for what, वा or, हेतोः reason, तत्त्वतः truly, ब्रूहि tell, शोभने O beautiful one
explanation: O gentle lady, whose daughter are you, and from where have you come here; O beautiful one, tell me truly what your purpose is or for what reason you are here.

shloka_text: एवमुक्ता तु सा कन्या कृताञ्जलिरथाब्रवीत् । आत्मप्रभावेण मुने ज्ञातुमर्हसि मे मतम् ।। 7.9.18 ।।
transliteration: evamuktā tu sā kanyā kṛtāñjalirathābravīt | ātmaprabhāveṇa mune jñātumarhasi me matam || 7.9.18 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्ता spoken to, तु indeed, सा she, कन्या the maiden, कृताञ्जलिः having made a respectful gesture with folded hands, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, आत्मप्रभावेण by your own spiritual power, मुने O sage, ज्ञातुम् to know, अर्हसि you ought, मे my, मतम् intention
explanation: Thus addressed, the maiden, having folded her hands, then spoke, saying, "O sage, you are capable of knowing my intention by your own spiritual power."

shloka_text: किं तु मां विद्धि ब्रह्मर्षे शासनात्पितुरागताम् । कैकसी नाम नाम्नाहं शेषं त्वं ज्ञातुमर्हसि ।। 7.9.19 ।।
transliteration: kiṃ tu māṃ viddhi brahmarṣe śāsanātpiturāgatām | kaikasī nāma nāmnāhaṃ śeṣaṃ tvaṃ jñātumarhasi || 7.9.19 ||
translation: किम् but, तु indeed, माम् me, विद्धि know, ब्रह्मर्षे O Brahmarshi, शासनात् by the command, पितुः of my father, आगताम् having come, कैकसी Kaikasi, नाम named, नाम्ना by name, अहम् I, शेषम् the rest, त्वम् you, ज्ञातुम् to know, अर्हसि you ought
explanation: "But know me, O Brahmarshi, as one who has come by the command of my father; I am named Kaikasi by name, and you are capable of knowing the rest."

shloka_text: स तु गत्वा मुनिर्ध्यानं वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह । विज्ञातं ते मया भद्रे कारणं यन्मनोगतम् ।। 7.9.20 ।।
transliteration: sa tu gatvā munirdhyānaṃ vākyametaduvāca ha | vijñātaṃ te mayā bhadre kāraṇaṃ yanmanogatam || 7.9.20 ||
translation: सः He, तु indeed, गत्वा having gone, मुनिः the sage, ध्यानम् into meditation, वाक्यम् words, एतत् these, उवाच spoke, ह indeed, विज्ञातम् known, ते your, मया by me, भद्रे O auspicious one, कारणम् the reason, यत् which, मनोगतम् residing in the mind
explanation: The sage, having then entered into meditation, spoke these words: "O gentle lady, the reason that was in your mind has been known by me."

shloka_text: सुताभिलाषो मत्तस्ते मत्तमातङ्गगामिनि । दारुणायां तु वेलायां यस्मात्त्वं मामुपस्थिता ।। 7.9.21 ।।
transliteration: sutābhilāṣo mattaste mattamātaṅgagāmini | dāruṇāyāṃ tu velāyāṃ yasmāttvaṃ māmupasthitā || 7.9.21 ||
translation: सुताभिलाषो desire for a son, मत्तः from me, ते your, मत्तमातङ्गगामिनि O you who walk like an intoxicated elephant, दारुणायां terrible, तु indeed, वेलायां at the time, यस्मात् because, त्वं you, माम् me, उपस्थिता approached.
explanation: O you who walk like an intoxicated elephant, since you have approached me at this dreadful time with a desire for a son from me.

shloka_text: शृणु तस्मात्सुतान्भद्रे यादृशाञ्जनयिष्यसि । दारुणान्दारुणाकारान्दारुणाभिजनप्रियान् ।। 7.9.22 ।।
transliteration: śṛṇu tasmātsutānbhadre yādṛśāñjanayiṣyasi | dāruṇāndāruṇākārāndāruṇābhijanapriyān || 7.9.22 ||
translation: शृणु listen, तस्मात् therefore, सुतान् sons, भद्रे O auspicious one, यादृशान् of what kind, जनयिष्यसि you will give birth to, दारुणान् terrible, दारुणाकारान् of dreadful appearance, दारुणाभिजनप्रियान् fond of cruel deeds.
explanation: Therefore, O auspicious one, listen to the kind of sons you will give birth to: they will be terrible, of dreadful appearance, and fond of cruel deeds.

shloka_text: प्रसविष्यसि सुश्रोणि राक्षसान्क्रूरकर्मणः । सा तु तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रणिपत्याब्रवीद्वचः ।। 7.9.23 ।।
transliteration: prasaviṣyasi suśroṇi rākṣasānkrūrakarmaṇaḥ | sā tu tadvacanaṃ śrutvā praṇipatyābravīdvacaḥ || 7.9.23 ||
translation: प्रसविष्यसि you will give birth to, सुश्रोणि O lady with beautiful hips, राक्षसान् demons, क्रूरकर्मणः of cruel deeds, सा she, तु but, तद्वचनं his words, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्रणिपत्य having bowed down, अब्रवीत् spoke, वचः words.
explanation: O lady with beautiful hips, you will give birth to Rakshasas who perform cruel deeds; but she, having heard his words, bowed down and spoke.

shloka_text: भगवन्नीदृशान्पुत्रांस्त्वत्तो ऽहं ब्रह्मवादिनः । नेच्छामि सुदुराचारान्प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि ।। 7.9.24 ।।
transliteration: bhagavannīdṛśānputrāṃstvatto 'haṃ brahmavādinaḥ | necchāmi sudurācārānprasādaṃ kartumarhasi || 7.9.24 ||
translation: भगवन् O venerable one, ईदृशान् such, पुत्रान् sons, त्वत्तः from you, अहं I, ब्रह्मवादिनः O speaker of Brahman, नेच्छामि do not desire, सुदुराचारान् extremely ill-behaved, प्रसादं favor, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि you ought.
explanation: O venerable one, O speaker of Brahman, I do not desire such extremely ill-behaved sons from you; please show me your grace.

shloka_text: कन्यया त्वेवमुक्तस्तु विश्रवा मुनिपुङ्गवः । उवाच कैकसीं भूयः पूर्णेन्दुरिव रोहिणीम् ।। 7.9.25 ।।
transliteration: kanyayā tvevamuktastu viśravā munipuṅgavaḥ | uvāca kaikasīṃ bhūyaḥ pūrṇenduriva rohiṇīm || 7.9.25 ||
translation: कन्यया by the maiden, तु indeed, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken to, तु indeed, विश्रवा Vishrava, मुनिपुङ्गवः foremost among sages, उवाच spoke, कैकसीं to Kaikasi, भूयः again, पूर्णेन्दुः the full moon, इव like, रोहिणीम् to Rohini.
explanation: But Vishrava, the foremost among sages, thus spoken to by the maiden, spoke again to Kaikasi, just as the full moon speaks to Rohini.

shloka_text: पश्चिमो यस्तव सुतो भविष्यति शुभानने । मम वंशानुरूपः स धर्मात्मा च भविष्यति ।। 7.9.26 ।।
transliteration: paścimo yastava suto bhaviṣyati śubhānane | mama vaṃśānurūpaḥ sa dharmātmā ca bhaviṣyati || 7.9.26 ||
translation: पश्चिमो the last one, यः who, तव your, सुतः son, भविष्यति will be, शुभानने O fair-faced one, मम my, वंशानुरूपः suitable to the lineage, सः he, धर्मात्मा righteous-souled, च and, भविष्यति will be.
explanation: O fair-faced one, your last son will be worthy of my lineage and will be righteous.

shloka_text: एवमुक्ता तु सा कन्या राम कालेन केनचित् । जनयामास बीभत्सं रक्षोरूपं सुदारुणम् ।। 7.9.27 ।।
transliteration: evamuktā tu sā kanyā rāma kālena kenacit | janayāmāsa bībhatsaṃ rakṣorūpaṃ sudāruṇam || 7.9.27 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्ता spoken to, तु indeed, सा that, कन्या maiden, राम O Rama, कालेन by time, केनचित् by some, जनयामास gave birth to, बीभत्सं repulsive, रक्षोरूपं having the form of a Rakshasa, सुदारुणम् very terrible.
explanation: O Rama, that maiden, thus addressed, after some time gave birth to a repulsive and very terrible Rakshasa-shaped child.

shloka_text: दशग्रीवं महादंष्ट्रं नीलाञ्जनचयोपमम् । ताम्रोष्ठं विंशतिभुजं महास्यं दीप्तमूर्धजम् ।। 7.9.28 ।।
transliteration: daśagrīvaṃ mahādaṃṣṭraṃ nīlāñjanacayopamam | tāmroṣṭhaṃ viṃśatibhujaṃ mahāsyaṃ dīptamūrdhajam || 7.9.28 ||
translation: दशग्रीवं having ten necks, महादंष्ट्रं having great fangs, नीलाञ्जनचयोपमम् resembling a heap of blue collyrium, ताम्रोष्ठं having copper-red lips, विंशतिभुजं having twenty arms, महास्यं having a huge mouth, दीप्तमूर्धजम् having blazing hair.
explanation: The child had ten necks, great fangs, resembled a heap of blue collyrium, possessed copper-red lips, twenty arms, a huge mouth, and blazing hair.

shloka_text: तस्मिञ्जाते तु तत्काले सज्वालकवलाः शिवाः । क्रव्यादाश्चापसव्यानि मण्डलानि प्रचक्रमुः ।। 7.9.29 ।।
transliteration: tasmiñjāte tu tatkāle sajvālakavalāḥ śivāḥ | kravyādāścāpasavyāni maṇḍalāni pracakramuḥ || 7.9.29 ||
translation: तस्मिन् when he, जाते was born, तु indeed, तत्काले at that very time, सज्वालकवलाः having mouthfuls of flames, शिवाः jackals, क्रव्यादाः flesh-eaters, च and, अपसव्यानि inauspicious, मण्डलानि circles, प्रचक्रमुः moved around.
explanation: At the very moment of his birth, jackals with flaming mouths and other carnivorous animals moved in inauspicious anti-clockwise circles.

shloka_text: ववर्ष रुधिरं देवो मेघाश्च खरनिःस्वनाः । प्रबभौ न च सूर्यो वै महोल्काश्चापतन्भुवि ।। 7.9.30 ।।
transliteration: vavarṣa rudhiraṃ devo meghāśca kharaniḥsvanāḥ | prababhau na ca sūryo vai maholkāścāpatanbhuvi || 7.9.30 ||
translation: ववर्ष rained, रुधिरं blood, देवः the god, मेघाः clouds, च and, खरनिःस्वनाः roaring loudly, प्रबभौ shone, न not, च and, सूर्यः the sun, वै indeed, महोल्काः great meteors, च and, आपतन् fell, भुवि on the earth.
explanation: The sky rained blood, clouds roared harshly, the sun did not shine, and great meteors fell upon the earth.

shloka_text: चकम्पे जगती चैव ववुर्वाताः सुदारुणाः । अक्षोभ्यः क्षुभितश्चैव समुद्रः सरितां पतिः ।। 7.9.31 ।।
transliteration: cakampe jagatī caiva vavurvātāḥ sudāruṇāḥ | akṣobhyaḥ kṣubhitaścaiva samudraḥ saritāṃ patiḥ || 7.9.31 ||
translation: चकम्पे trembled, जगती the earth, चैव and, ववुः blew, वाताः winds, सुदारुणाः very fierce, अक्षोभ्यः unagitated, क्षुभितश्चैव and became agitated, समुद्रः the ocean, सरितां पतिः lord of rivers.
explanation: The earth trembled, very fierce winds blew, and even the unshakeable ocean, the lord of rivers, became agitated.

shloka_text: अथ नामाकरोत्तस्य पितामहसमः पिता । दशग्रीवः प्रसूतो ऽयं दशग्रीवो भविष्यति ।। 7.9.32 ।।
transliteration: atha nāmākarottasya pitāmahasamaḥ pitā | daśagrīvaḥ prasūto 'yaṃ daśagrīvo bhaviṣyati || 7.9.32 ||
translation: अथ then, नामाकरोत् named, तस्य his, पितामहसमः like his grandfather, पिता father, दशग्रीवः ten-necked, प्रसूतो ऽयम् this one born, दशग्रीवः ten-necked, भविष्यति will be.
explanation: Then his father, who was like his grandfather (Brahma), named him Daśagrīva, declaring that this newborn would indeed be Daśagrīva (ten-necked).

shloka_text: तस्य त्वनन्तरं जातः कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः । प्रमाणाद्यस्य विपुलं प्रमाणं नेह विद्यते ।। 7.9.33 ।।
transliteration: tasya tvanantaraṃ jātaḥ kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ | pramāṇādyasya vipulaṃ pramāṇaṃ neha vidyate || 7.9.33 ||
translation: तस्य his, तु indeed, अनन्तरम् subsequently, जातः was born, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, महाबलः immensely powerful, प्रमाणात् in measure, यस्य whose, विपुलम् vast, प्रमाणम् measure, न not, इह here, विद्यते exists.
explanation: After him, the immensely powerful Kumbhakarna was born, whose vast size and measure had no equal in this world.

shloka_text: ततः शूर्पणखा नाम सञ्जज्ञे विकृतानना । विभीषणश्च धर्मात्मा कैकस्याः पश्चिमः सुतः ।। 7.9.34 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ śūrpaṇakhā nāma sañjajñe vikṛtānanā | vibhīṣaṇaśca dharmātmā kaikasyāḥ paścimaḥ sutaḥ || 7.9.34 ||
translation: ततः then, शूर्पणखा Shurpanakha, नाम named, सञ्जज्ञे was born, विकृतानना with a deformed face, विभीषणश्च and Vibhishana, धर्मात्मा righteous-souled, कैकस्याः of Kaikasi, पश्चिमः last, सुतः son.
explanation: Then Shurpanakha, named for her deformed face, was born, followed by Vibhishana, the righteous-souled last son of Kaikasi.

shloka_text: तस्मिञ्जाते महासत्त्वे पुष्पवर्षं पपात ह ।। 7.9.35 ।।
transliteration: tasmiñjāte mahāsattve puṣpavarṣaṃ papāta ha || 7.9.35 ||
translation: तस्मिन् when he, जाते was born, महासत्त्वे the great being, पुष्पवर्षम् a shower of flowers, पपात fell, ह indeed.
explanation: Indeed, when that great being (Vibhishana) was born, a shower of flowers fell.

shloka_text: नभःस्थाने दुन्दुभयो देवानां प्राणदंस्तदा । वाक्यं चैवान्तरिक्षे च साधु साध्विति तत्तदा ।। 7.9.36 ।।
transliteration: nabhaḥsthāne dundubhayo devānāṃ prāṇadaṃstadā | vākyaṃ caivāntarikṣe ca sādhu sādhviti tattadā || 7.9.36 ||
translation: नभःस्थाने in the sky, दुन्दुभयो drums, देवानां of the gods, प्राणदंस्तदा then sounded, वाक्यं a voice, चैव and also, अन्तरिक्षे in the sky, च and, साधु साध्विति "Excellent! Excellent!", तत् that, तदा then.
explanation: Then, drums of the gods sounded in the sky, and a voice from the heavens exclaimed, "Excellent! Excellent!"

shloka_text: तौ तु तत्र महारण्ये ववृधाते महौजसौ । कुम्भकर्णदशग्रीवौ लोकोद्वेगकरौ तदा ।। 7.9.37 ।।
transliteration: tau tu tatra mahāraṇye vavṛdhāte mahaujasau | kumbhakarṇadaśagrīvau lokodvegakarau tadā || 7.9.37 ||
translation: तौ those two, तु indeed, तत्र there, महारण्ये in the great forest, ववृधाते grew up, महौजसौ very powerful, कुम्भकर्णदशग्रीवौ Kumbhakarna and Dashagriva, लोकोद्वेगकरौ causing distress to the world, तदा then.
explanation: Then, those two, Kumbhakarna and Dashagriva, grew up in that great forest, becoming exceedingly powerful and a cause of distress to the world.

shloka_text: कुम्भकर्णः प्रमत्तस्तु महर्षीन्धर्मवत्सलान् । त्रैलोक्यं भक्षयन्नित्यासन्तुष्टो विचचार ह ।। 7.9.38 ।।
transliteration: kumbhakarṇaḥ pramattastu maharṣīndharmavatsalān | trailokyaṃ bhakṣayannityāsantuṣṭo vicacāra ha || 7.9.38 ||
translation: कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, प्रमत्तस्तु but reckless, महर्षीन् great sages, धर्मवत्सलान् devoted to dharma, त्रैलोक्यं the three worlds, भक्षयन् devouring, नित्य always, असन्तुष्टो unsatisfied, विचचार roamed, ह indeed.
explanation: Kumbhakarna, reckless and ever unsatisfied, roamed about, devouring great sages devoted to dharma and causing havoc in the three worlds.

shloka_text: विभीषणस्तु धर्मात्मा नित्यं धर्मे व्यवस्थितः । स्वाध्यायनियताहार उवास विजितेन्द्रियः ।। 7.9.39 ।।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇastu dharmātmā nityaṃ dharme vyavasthitaḥ | svādhyāyaniyatāhāra uvāsa vijitendriyaḥ || 7.9.39 ||
translation: विभीषणस्तु but Vibhishana, धर्मात्मा righteous-souled, नित्यं always, धर्मे in righteousness, व्यवस्थितः established, स्वाध्यायनियताहार with self-study and controlled diet, उवास lived, विजितेन्द्रियः with controlled senses.
explanation: In contrast, Vibhishana, a righteous soul, always remained steadfast in dharma, living with self-study, a controlled diet, and mastery over his senses.

shloka_text: अथ वैश्रवणो देवस्तत्र कालेन केनचित् । आगतः पितरं द्रष्टुं पुष्पकेण धनेश्वरः ।। 7.9.40 ।।
transliteration: atha vaiśravaṇo devastatra kālena kenacit | āgataḥ pitaraṃ draṣṭuṃ puṣpakeṇa dhaneśvaraḥ || 7.9.40 ||
translation: अथ then, वैश्रवणो Vaishravana, देवः the god, तत्र there, कालेन केनचित् after some time, आगतः came, पितरं father, द्रष्टुं to see, पुष्पकेण by Pushpaka (chariot), धनेश्वरः the lord of wealth.
explanation: Then, after some time, the god Vaishravana, the lord of wealth, came there in his Pushpaka chariot to see his father.

shloka_text: तं दृष्ट्वा कैकसी तत्र ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा । आगम्य राक्षसी तत्र दशग्रीवमुवाच ह ।। 7.9.41 ।।
transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā kaikasī tatra jvalantamiva tejasā | āgamya rākṣasī tatra daśagrīvamuvāca ha || 7.9.41 ||
translation: तम् him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, कैकसी Kaikasi, तत्र there, ज्वलन्तम् shining, इव as if, तेजसा with splendor, आगम्य having come, राक्षसी the demoness, तत्र there, दशग्रीवम् to Dashagriva, उवाच said, ह indeed
explanation: Having seen him (Kubera) shining with splendor there, Kaikasi, the demoness, came to Dashagriva (Ravana) and indeed spoke to him.

shloka_text: पुत्र वैश्रवणं पश्य भ्रातरं तेजसा वृतम् । भ्रातृभावे समे चापि पश्यात्मानं त्वमीदृशम् ।। 7.9.42 ।।
transliteration: putra vaiśravaṇaṃ paśya bhrātaraṃ tejasā vṛtam | bhrātṛbhāve same cāpi paśyātmānaṃ tvamīdṛśam || 7.9.42 ||
translation: पुत्र O son, वैश्रवणम् Vaishravana, पश्य behold, भ्रातरम् your brother, तेजसा with splendor, वृतम् endowed, भ्रातृभावे in brotherhood, समे equal, च and, अपि even, पश्य behold, आत्मानम् yourself, त्वम् you, ईदृशम् such
explanation: "O son, behold your brother Vaishravana, endowed with splendor, and even though you are equal in brotherhood, behold yourself in such a state."

shloka_text: दशग्रीव तथा यत्नं कुरुष्वामितविक्रम । यथा त्वमसि मे पुत्र भव र्वैश्रवणोपमः ।। 7.9.43 ।।
transliteration: daśagrīva tathā yatnaṃ kuruṣvāmitavikrama | yathā tvamasi me putra bhava rvaiśravaṇopamaḥ || 7.9.43 ||
translation: दशग्रीव O Dashagriva, तथा thus, यत्नम् effort, कुरुष्व make, अमितविक्रम O one of immeasurable valor, यथा so that, त्वम् you, असि are, मे my, पुत्र son, भव become, वैश्रवणोपमः equal to Vaishravana
explanation: "O Dashagriva, O one of immeasurable valor, make such an effort, my son, so that you become equal to Vaishravana."

shloka_text: मातुस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान् । अमर्षमतुलं लेभे प्रतिज्ञां चाकरोत्तदा ।। 7.9.44 ।।
transliteration: mātustadvacanaṃ śrutvā daśagrīvaḥ pratāpavān | amarṣamatulaṃ lebhe pratijñāṃ cākarottadā || 7.9.44 ||
translation: मातुः of the mother, तत् that, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, प्रतापवान् valorous, अमर्षम् indignation, अतुलम् unequalled, लेभे obtained, प्रतिज्ञाम् a vow, च and, अकरोत् made, तदा then
explanation: Having heard that speech of his mother, the valorous Dashagriva felt unequalled indignation and then made a vow.

shloka_text: सत्यं ते प्रतिजानामि भ्रातृतुल्यो ऽधिको ऽपि वा । भविष्याम्योजसा चैव सन्तापं त्यज हृद्गतम् ।। 7.9.45 ।।
transliteration: satyaṃ te pratijānāmi bhrātṛtulyo 'dhiko 'pi vā | bhaviṣyāmyojasā caiva santāpaṃ tyaja hṛdgatam || 7.9.45 ||
translation: सत्यम् truly, ते to you, प्रतिजानामि I promise, भ्रातृतुल्यः equal to brother, अधिकः superior, अपि even, वा or, भविष्यामि I shall become, ओजसा with might, च and, एव indeed, सन्तापम् sorrow, त्यज abandon, हृद्गतम् residing in the heart
explanation: "Truly, I promise you that I shall become either equal to or even superior to my brother in might; therefore, abandon the sorrow residing in your heart."

shloka_text: ततस्तेनैव कोपेन दशग्रीवः सहानुजः । चिकीर्षुर्दुष्करं कर्म तपसे धृतमानसः ।। 7.9.46 ।।
transliteration: tatastenaiva kopena daśagrīvaḥ sahānujaḥ | cikīrṣurduṣkaraṃ karma tapase dhṛtamānasaḥ || 7.9.46 ||
translation: ततः then, तेनैव by that very, कोपेन anger, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, सहानुजः with his younger brothers, चिकीर्षुः desiring to do, दुष्करं difficult, कर्म deed, तपसे for penance, धृतमानसः with a mind set
explanation: Then, filled with that very anger, Dashagriva, along with his younger brothers, set his mind on performing a difficult penance.

shloka_text: प्राप्स्यामि तपसा काममिति कृत्वा ऽध्यवस्य च । आगच्छदात्मसिद्ध्यर्थं गोकर्णस्याश्रमं शुभम् ।। 7.9.47 ।।
transliteration: prāpsyāmi tapasā kāmamiti kṛtvā 'dhyavasya ca | āgacchadātmasiddhyarthaṃ gokarṇasyāśramaṃ śubham || 7.9.47 ||
translation: प्राप्स्यामि I shall obtain, तपसा through penance, कामम् my desire, इति thus, कृत्वा having thought, अध्यवस्य having resolved, च and, आगच्छत् he came, आत्मसिद्ध्यर्थं for the accomplishment of his own purpose, गोकर्णस्य of Gokarna, आश्रमं hermitage, शुभम् auspicious
explanation: Having resolved that he would achieve his desires through penance, he then came to the auspicious hermitage of Gokarna for the accomplishment of his own purpose.

shloka_text: स राक्षसस्तत्र सहानुजस्तदा तपश्चकारातुलमुग्रविक्रमः । अतोषयच्चापि पितामहं विभुं ददौ स तुष्टश्च वराञ्जयावहान् ।। 7.9.48 ।।
transliteration: sa rākṣasastatra sahānujastadā tapaścakārātulamugravikramaḥ | atoṣayaccāpi pitāmahaṃ vibhuṃ dadau sa tuṣṭaśca varāñjayāvahān || 7.9.48 ||
translation: सः that, राक्षसः demon, तत्र there, सहानुजः with his younger brothers, तदा then, तपश्चकार performed penance, अतुलम् incomparable, उग्रविक्रमः of fierce prowess, अतोषयत् he pleased, च and, अपि also, पितामहं the grandfather (Brahma), विभुं the lord, ददौ he gave, सः he, तुष्टः pleased, च and, वरान् boons, जयावहान् bringing victory
explanation: That demon of fierce prowess, along with his younger brothers, then performed incomparable penance there, and he also pleased the lord Brahma, who, being pleased, granted him boons that brought victory. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे नवमः सर्गः ।। 9 ।। Thus ends the ninth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
